definitions.explanation: A small pin or clip used to hold hair in place. Also used of a sharp U-shaped bend in a road (ヘアピンカーブ).

examples.japanese: ヘアピン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I pin it up with a hairpin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前髪|まえがみ}→前髪：19004_maegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ヘアピン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I hold my bangs back with a bobby pin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ヘアピン⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The mountain road has one hairpin bend after another, so you have to drive very carefully.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヘアピン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧: to fasten with a hairpin
- ヘアピン⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧: a hairpin bend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧: pin — the general word; in hair, ⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧ alone often means a bobby pin
- ヘアゴム: hair tie
- {髪留|かみど}め: hair clip, barrette — the native word
